The '''Suarbi system''', in the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]], contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Suarbi 7]] and the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Suarbi 7|Suarbi]]. It was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] between the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. Its only colonized location was Suarbi 7's fifth [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Susevfi]]
